head.h1: Tasting Menu Catering in Dubai — Real Prices, Menus and Timings

opening_paragraph: Tasting menu catering Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 1,400 per person: a set, multi-course, chef's-choice dinner plated in your home, course by course, with optional beverage pairing. Tell us your date, guest count and venue, and during our published business hours a full itemised proposal comes back promptly, shaped around your occasion, your cuisine and any dietary needs at the table.

new_paragraphs: Your tasting menu is built with you, not handed to you. Most evenings run five, seven or nine courses: a cold opener, one or two seafood or vegetable courses, a pasta or grain course, a main protein, a pre-dessert and a dessert, with canapés or an amuse to start. Those opening canapés are finger food in the literal sense — two or three bites taken standing, with a drink, before anyone sits down. You choose the register, whether classical French, modern Mediterranean, Levantine, or a route through several cuisines, and the kitchen shapes each course to the season and to your guests. Every menu is fully halal on request, and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free routes, along with menus without intentionally added nuts, are designed in from the first draft rather than added late, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. As a tasting menu food catering service, Partners source produce close to the date so the courses taste of when they are cooked, then shares the full run of plates for your sign-off before the night.

new_paragraphs: A tasting menu is a set, multi-course meal chosen by the chef and served one plate at a time, and myCHEF brings that restaurant format into your own dining room. You get the food, the format and the full service: a sequence of small, precise courses, often five to eight, built around a season, a technique or a single ingredient, plus the chef on site, plating, table service, setup and cleanup. Where an à la carte dinner has every guest ordering differently, a tasting menu moves the whole table through the same story at the same pace. As a full tasting menu catering services provider, myCHEF designs the run of courses with you, brings the china, glassware and linen the table needs, and finishes every plate to order. You follow the courses; the kitchen keeps the clock.

add_block.new_heading: Tasting menus for weddings, corporate events and parties
new_paragraphs: A tasting menu suits any occasion where the meal is the event, not the backdrop. Intimate weddings, milestone anniversaries, corporate dinners and small private parties all read beautifully as a plated tasting. For a wedding or an engagement, the format turns dinner into the centrepiece: paced courses, a quiet flourish between each, and a chef who works to your run-of-show. Corporate tasting menu catering in Dubai gives a board dinner or a client evening a considered, unhurried rhythm a buffet cannot match. Smaller tasting menu party catering, for a birthday, a reunion or a farewell, lets a handful of guests eat the way a fine-dining room would serve them without leaving home. Tasting menu catering for events across Dubai scales from a table of four to a long table of twenty, with the course count and pacing set to the room.

add_block.new_heading: How much does tasting menu catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: A tasting menu in Dubai starts at AED 1,400 per person, and where your evening lands depends on the number of courses, the group size, the ingredients and whether you add a pairing. Fewer guests and rarer produce, such as a whole turbot, aged beef or a caviar course, sit at the upper end; a shorter five-course run for a larger table brings the per-head figure down, which is where more affordable tasting menu catering becomes workable. MyCHEF quotes tasting menu catering prices as one itemised figure covering food, chef, service and setup, with no service charge stacked on top, so what you approve is what you pay. For a sense of tasting menu catering cost against other formats, see our prices and the fuller catering price guide , then ask for a quote built to your date.

new_paragraphs: How much does a tasting menu cost in Dubai?
A tasting menu starts at AED 1,400 per person, quoted by course count, group size, ingredients and whether you add a pairing. Send your date and numbers for an exact, itemised figure.
How many courses is a tasting menu?
Most tasting menus run five, seven or nine courses, from an opener and seafood or vegetable plates through a main protein to a pre-dessert and dessert. You set the length with the chef.
Can the tasting menu be halal?
Yes. Every tasting menu can be prepared fully halal, with halal-certified meat and no pork or alcohol in the cooking, without changing the ambition of the courses.
Do you offer wine or non-alcoholic pairings?
Both. You can add a course-by-course wine flight or a non-alcoholic pairing of cordials, teas and infusions, each pour matched and paced to the plate beside it.
Can you cater a tasting menu for a wedding or corporate dinner?
Yes. Tasting menu catering for events covers weddings, engagements, corporate dinners and private parties, scaled from a small table to twenty guests with the pacing set to the occasion.
Do I need a professional kitchen at home?
No. A tasting menu home catering setup needs only counter space, a sink and standard power; the chef brings the equipment, plating and service the menu requires.
How do I hire a tasting menu chef in Dubai?
Send your date, guest count and venue to myCHEF, approve the itemised proposal, confirm the run of courses, and a vetted chef arrives on the day to cook, serve and clear.
How much will it cost to feed 40 guests?

Tasting menus are priced per head, so 40 guests is the per-person figure multiplied by 40, from AED 1,400 each, plus 5% VAT. At that headcount many hosts shorten the run to five courses or change format instead: an event buffet starts from AED 120 per person and a premium buffet or live-station spread from AED 150.
What is the most expensive food in Dubai?

The cost sits in ingredients rather than dishes. Caviar, truffle in season, aged and heavily marbled beef, and whole prime fish such as turbot are what lift a Dubai menu, and one of them in one course moves the whole per-head figure. We tell you which course carries the cost before you approve the menu.
Is there a tasting menu PDF I can download?

No, because no two of these dinners share a menu, so a generic tasting menu catering Dubai PDF would describe nobody's evening. You get the run of courses written for your date instead, sent with the itemised proposal for sign-off, as a PDF if you want it on paper.
For tasting menu catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: A tasting menu at home versus a restaurant tasting menu
new_paragraphs: Most tasting menus in Dubai are eaten in restaurants, and a restaurant tasting menu is the simpler booking: reserve, arrive, eat what that kitchen has decided to serve this season. What you trade away is the room and the pace. At home the menu is written for your table rather than for a full dining room, courses land when your evening is ready for them, and nobody is waiting on the seating to turn over. It is also the only version where the run of courses can be built around what one specific guest at the table can and cannot eat. The trade in the other direction is cost: a restaurant absorbs the kitchen it already runs, while a tasting menu at home carries the chef, the service team and the equipment inside the per-head figure. If a restaurant tasting menu already suits the occasion, book one — this page is for the evenings where it does not.
Request a proposal or chat on WhatsApp , and most quotes land promptly during our published business hours.

new_paragraphs: MyCHEF arranges tasting menus across every part of Dubai, from Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Hills villas to Downtown and Marina apartments, Business Bay penthouses and DIFC private rooms, so a search for tasting menu catering near me lands on a chef who will travel to your table. A trusted tasting menu caterer should read the room as much as the menu: a compact apartment kitchen and a sprawling villa call for different setups, and the team plans the pass, the service flow and the timing to the space you host in. Outdoors it changes again: for a terrace or garden dinner the kitchen sets up close to the seating so plates travel seconds rather than minutes, and the menu leans away from anything that suffers in Dubai heat, which is the practical difference between a plated tasting and ordinary outdoor catering in Dubai. Wherever you are, the standard holds, with the same vetted chefs, the same itemised quote and the same full service. If you are still weighing formats, our note on private chef vs catering lays out the surest way to match a format to the evening, and you can explore the wider luxury dining range, from a chef's table to a date night .
